info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Industrial Engineering and Systems Management

description.describe_ch: 為了發展永續的社會，工業和服務業需要了解如何應對環境，經濟和社會挑戰以及改變工業行為。課程介紹了該領域當前的思想和知識，並介紹了加速向永續工業體系過渡的途徑。課程將以英語進行。
description.describe_eh: To develop more sustainable societies, industries and service sectors need to better understand how to respond to environmental, economic and social challenges and transform industrial behavior. The course addresses current thinking and knowledge in this area, and introduces tools that accelerate the transition towards a sustainable industrial system. The course will be conducted in English.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠運用課堂所學理論於實務及具有國際觀。
targets.describe_en: Able to apply relevant theory in practice and have an international view.

targets.describe_ch: 強化英語溝通、協調及提升將來升學或就業競爭力。
targets.describe_en: To strengthen communication, coordination and enhancing the competitiveness of future studies or employment in English.

targets.describe_ch: 強調跨領域整合方式，增進團隊合作能力。
targets.describe_en: To emphasis on the integration of cross-disciplines and to strengthen students'capability of creative research and team work

targets.describe_ch: .具有應用研究成果之整合能力並理解專業倫理與國際觀。
targets.describe_en: Able to integrate applied research results and understand professional ethics and international outlook.
